hkbu.summary: (MScDABE & MScAECON) Teaching Support & Programme Operations — Aug 2023 – Present | Kowloon, HK

Collect and analyze student assignment, examination, and feedback data to assist course leaders in compiling teaching effectiveness reports. Maintain collaborative working relationships with multiple faculty members and elective instructors to ensure integrated programme delivery.
